name: MedMCQA: Multi-Subject Multiple-Choice Medical Question Answering Benchmark
description: MedMCQA is a large-scale, multiple-choice question answering dataset compiled to advance biomedical cognitive AI and medical education assessment. Published in the Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR / CHIL 2022) by researchers from the Indian Institute of Science and AIIMS, the dataset comprises over 194,000 multiple-choice questions collected from past Indian medical entrance examinations (AIIMS PG and NEET-PG). Spanning 21 preclinical, paraclinical, and clinical subjects and covering 2,400 healthcare topics, MedMCQA features 4-option multiple-choice questions accompanied by subject tags, topic classifications, and detailed explanatory solution rationales.

Although the Hugging Face dataset card specifies Apache-2.0, the primary data source provides no explicit commercial license. Commercial permission is unknown.
